abilities.name: Attack
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: Convention: every class ships a free rank-1 Attack.

abilities.name: Heavy Blow
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Heavy Blow (line hit, high threat, grants Vanguard's Might's party damage-reduction aura)'. The cheap high-threat filler - Warrior's heroic_strike curve.

abilities.name: Ram
abilities.description: Drive your shield into an enemy, the blow landing harder the heavier the shield you carry.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Ram is Shield Slam'. Shield-gated single-target payoff, so it sits on a short cooldown.

abilities.name: Pulverize
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Pulverize as your Energy-dump filler ... cleaves on multi-mob pulls', Devastate analog.

abilities.name: Advance
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target and stuns it.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Advance is Charge', 'a forced 100%-speed gap-close'. Charge stuns, so is_stun.

abilities.name: Brace
abilities.description: Set your feet and angle your shield, turning aside blows that would have landed clean.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Brace and Raise Shield are Shield Block and Shield Wall'. Block CHANCE, not value - block_chance is the shield-gated roll (Character.BASE_BLOCK_CHANCE).

abilities.name: Raise Shield
abilities.description: Plant your shield and weather everything coming at you.
abilities._source: Shield Wall analog - same -40% for 2 turns on a 12 turn cooldown as warrior_shield_wall, deliberately identical so neither plate tank has a better panic button.

abilities.name: Bastion
abilities.description: Damage taken -15% for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Bastion is a group damage-reduction window'. The party-facing layer that makes CoA label Guardian support.

abilities.name: Tower Formation
abilities.description: Take a braced stance, slower to move but far harder to move.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Tower Formation a personal block/armor stance via the Formations'. Formations share one slot.

abilities.name: Formation of the Line
abilities.description: Hold formation with your allies, every shield covering the one beside it.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Formation cuts damage 10%', and Formations are mutually exclusive - same exclusive_group as Tower.  UNIT FIXED: physical_damage_taken_pct in an ability's stat_mods is in PERCENT POINTS (Character.take_damage divides the physical_/magic_ variants by 100), so -0.1 meant -0.1% and did essentially nothing. The bare damage_taken_pct key sits four lines away in the same method and IS a fraction - the convention is per-key with no naming rule. Verified by applying the key and taking a 1000-damage hit: 0.04 gave 736 damage, 4.0 gave 766. Caught by the unit check added to tools/validate_class.py, which flags both directions.

abilities.name: Challenging Cry
abilities.description: Threat generated +200% for 2 turns.
abilities._source: AoE taunt. Implemented as a threat_generation_pct buff, the convention Cultist's Twilight Domain (180) and Primalist's Heart of the Mountain (150) already use - ability buff stat_mods are percent POINTS here, unlike talent effects which are fractions.

abilities.name: Shield Challenge
abilities.description: Batter your shield and single out one enemy, who can think of nothing else.
abilities._source: Single-target taunt, cheaper and shorter than the cry.

abilities.name: Hammer of Kings
abilities.description: Deals damage to up to 4 targets.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Hammer of Kings is an AoE slam that slows casting'. The pull opener.

abilities.name: Hammer of the Law
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Hammer of the Law is a line hit that silences, not a Shockwave stun' - explicitly NOT a stun, so no is_stun here even though the AoE opener tempts it.

abilities.name: Lionheart
abilities.description: Heals you.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Lionheart's emergency heal when you're dropped low'. One of only three heals in the whole class.

abilities.name: Final Verdict
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target and heals you for part of it. Usable only below 25% health.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Save Final Verdict to finish an enemy below the execute threshold for the self-heal'. Shared by Vanguard and Gladiator.

abilities.name: Knight's Calling
abilities.description: Restores energy to you.
abilities._source: CoA: 'the class kit's Knight's Calling, a periodic health-and-Energy restore that costs a class pick'.

abilities.name: Broad Sweep
abilities.description: Deals damage to up to 3 targets.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Broad Sweep as your energy-dump filler and cleave'.

abilities.name: Ballad of Steel
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'cast Ballads on cooldown (instant damage + builds Tempo toward a free Sound of War)'. Physical, not magical - the class blurb calls the Guardian 'non-magical'.

abilities.name: Song of Steel
abilities.description: Attack Power Pct +12% for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Song of Steel and Inspiring Presence scaling off your attack power = Ebon Might scaling off the Evoker'. This is the Augmentation half of the spec. || target_type self -> party, 5 Nov 2026. CoA: 'Boost the morale of party and raid members, increasing their attack or spell power by 95 for 15 seconds.' It is a party buff in CoA and was authored as self, so the Guardian's own support spec buffed nobody but the Guardian. target_type 'party' resolves to every living ally (abilities.py:2064) and degrades to the caster when no party context is supplied, so a 1v1 fight still works.

abilities.name: Song of Battle
abilities.description: Deals damage to up to 4 targets over time for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Song of Battle for 3+ mobs, where damage ticks into an AoE stun finisher'.

abilities.name: Inspiring Presence
abilities.description: Attack Power +40, Physical crit chance +3 for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA names it alongside Song of Steel as the AP-scaling ally buff pair. || target_type self -> party, 5 Nov 2026. CoA: 'Emanate an aura around you for 15 seconds, causing allied players within 100 yds to deal 35% AP additional damage as Holy damage when they deal direct damage.' An ally-facing aura authored as self.

abilities.name: Standard of Valiance
abilities.description: Physical damage taken -12%, Stun duration +30% for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Plant Standard of Valiance at the point or chokepoint (Stand Your Ground! reduces allies' physical damage taken while they stand in it, You Shall Not Fall! gives them stun and grip resistance)'.  UNIT FIXED: physical_damage_taken_pct in an ability's stat_mods is in PERCENT POINTS (Character.take_damage divides the physical_/magic_ variants by 100), so -0.12 meant -0.12% and did essentially nothing. The bare damage_taken_pct key sits four lines away in the same method and IS a fraction - the convention is per-key with no naming rule. Verified by applying the key and taking a 1000-damage hit: 0.04 gave 736 damage, 4.0 gave 766. Caught by the unit check added to tools/validate_class.py, which flags both directions. NOTE the sibling key is NOT affected: stun_duration_reduction_pct 0.3 is a fraction and is correct, as is the Stand Your Ground! TALENT node's own -0.03 - the same key read as a talent effect IS a fraction. || target_type self -> party, 5 Nov 2026. CoA's Stand Your Ground!: 'While standing in your Standard of Valiance, your allies' Physical damage taken is reduced by 10%.' The whole point of the standard is that allies benefit. Note physical_damage_taken_pct inside a status effect is divided by 100 and POSITIVE increases damage taken, so the -12 here is a 12% reduction for the party.

abilities.name: Cavalry Charge
abilities.description: Deals damage to up to 3 targets.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Open packs with Cavalry Charge to close distance'.

abilities.name: Champion's Presence
abilities.description: Haste +15 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Pop Champion's Presence for a haste burst window'. || target_type self -> party, 5 Nov 2026. CoA: 'Enrage all nearby allies, increasing their haste by 30% for 20 seconds.' Explicitly allies-only in CoA; held at 15% party-wide rather than CoA's 30%.

abilities.name: Liberation
abilities.description: Grants an ally: Immune to crowd control for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Liberation / Cavalry Charge / Song of Battle's stun = Landslide root / Wing Buffet / Time Stop', and 'Hallucination sheds movement-impairing effects'. REMOVED NOTHING, EVER, UNTIL 2026-10-29: this was effect_type 'dispel' with dispel_type 'movement', and 'movement' is not a DispelType - the real members are NONE/MAGIC/CURSE/POISON/DISEASE - so remove_debuff_by_dispel_type took its guaranteed no-match path and the cast logged 'has no Movement effect to remove!' against a target visibly carrying four dispellable debuffs. Now a cc_immune buff, which is the shape the engine actually supports and the same one Ranger's Freedom and Cultist's Dark Veil already use; since apply_status_effect now also clears active stuns when cc_immune lands, this both frees the ally and keeps them free, which is closer to CoA than the dispel ever was.

abilities.name: Harrowing Melody
abilities.description: Applies to the target: Attack Power Pct -15% for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA lists Harrowing Melody among the cooldowns Voice of an Angel resets.

abilities.name: Hero's March
abilities.description: Haste +8, Physical damage taken -5% for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA lists Hero's March with Liberation and Harrowing Melody as the Voice of an Angel reset targets.  UNIT FIXED: physical_damage_taken_pct in an ability's stat_mods is in PERCENT POINTS (Character.take_damage divides the physical_/magic_ variants by 100), so -0.05 meant -0.05% and did essentially nothing. The bare damage_taken_pct key sits four lines away in the same method and IS a fraction - the convention is per-key with no naming rule. Verified by applying the key and taking a 1000-damage hit: 0.04 gave 736 damage, 4.0 gave 766. Caught by the unit check added to tools/validate_class.py, which flags both directions. The haste 8.0 beside it was already right - haste is points too.

abilities.name: Voice of an Angel
abilities.description: Resets your ability cooldowns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Voice of an Angel instantly resets Liberation, Harrowing Melody, and Hero's March when you need them back'.

abilities.name: Soldier's Decree
abilities.description: Attack Power +30, Stamina +8.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Spirit uniquely powers Soldier's/Spellcaster's/Hero's Decrees'. One decree at a time.

abilities.name: Spellcaster's Decree
abilities.description: Spell Power +30, Mp5 +6.
abilities._source: The caster-facing decree of the same trio.

abilities.name: Hero's Decree
abilities.description: Maximum health +8%, Physical crit chance +2, Spell crit chance +2.
abilities._source: The third and latest decree - both stats, smaller each.

abilities.name: Sound of War
abilities.description: Deals damage to up to 3 targets.
abilities._source: CoA's Inspiration tree is built around this: Ballads build Tempo toward a free Sound of War, and four talents (Soundwave, Into The Fray, Pied Piper, Frontliner) key off triggering one. It was missing from the first pass entirely, which left Soundwave scaling nothing.

abilities.name: Battle Rush
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target and stuns it.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Open with Battle Rush (charge + stun)'.

abilities.name: Spear Throw
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Spear Throw's healing-reduction debuff lets it punch through an enemy healer's output', 'Mortal Strike's anti-heal identity transplanted onto a shield-tank frame'. ranged_damage - it is thrown.

abilities.name: Net Throw
abilities.description: Applies to the target: Haste -20 for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Battle Rush (charge + stun) or Net Throw to close or lock a mob'.

abilities.name: Reprisal
abilities.description: Catch the blow on your shield and answer it in the same breath.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Fill remaining energy with Reprisal (spend charges after a block)'. Revenge-flavoured.

abilities.name: Centurion Strike
abilities.description: A practised, heavy strike - the kind that buys you another few seconds behind the shield.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Centurion Strike (bigger hit, weapon-dependent bonus, extends Raise Shield)'.

abilities.name: Glorious Arena
abilities.description: Deals damage to up to 5 targets over time for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Glorious Arena drops a ring that punishes enemies clumped on a node or choke point'.

abilities.name: Heroism
abilities.description: Makes your next cast instant.
abilities._source: CoA: 'lean on Heroism's free Pulverizes/Broad Sweeps once Glory or Favor peaks'.

abilities.name: Fearless
abilities.description: Damage taken -10% for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Use Veteran of the Third War's on-block heal and Fearless while surrounded'.
